name: Hawaii Energy Systems, LLC
old_description: Celebrating 20 years of connecting technologies, controlling environments, and conserving our 'aina!
about:
Hawaii Energy Systems, LLC operates from Aiea, Hawaii, where it has spent two decades connecting technologies and controlling environments for local facilities. The company marks its 20th anniversary this year, though a specific founding date is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

The firm specializes in building automation, providing automated control of HVAC and other building systems. Its solutions are described as powerful, highly scalable, and cost-effective even for the smallest facilities. Hawaii Energy Systems also acts as a brand-flexible representative for leading manufacturers in the energy and controls space, integrating multiple product lines rather than producing its own hardware.

Its customer base spans commercial and institutional buildings seeking energy efficiency and smarter environmental control. The company serves the building automation, HVAC, and clean-energy sectors, working with facility owners and managers who want to reduce energy consumption while maintaining comfort. Concrete project examples are not listed in the available materials.

Hawaii Energy Systems emphasizes a clean-energy mission, stating that if a system uses energy, they can make it smarter and more efficient. The company has earned the Energy Insider Award for nine consecutive years, a recognition it highlights as a differentiator. Its brand-flexible approach allows it to tailor solutions without allegiance to a single product line.
